meaning: E0c color-gated initialization followed by photometric ray-depth gradients, with matched E0b control
renderer: unchanged P2c compact_soft; normalized RGB without alpha multiplication
temperature_reference: initial E0b positive camera-Z median times fraction; identical frozen tau for both arms
train_mask: E1 F0 fixed mask intersect initial compact support alpha>=0.5 in BOTH arms; identical and frozen
active_set: same E3b policy: at least two source cameras, parallax>1e-6 degrees, visible in all original source cameras; arm-specific frozen indices
point_rgb: channel median of original observation RGB within each CSR group; fixed
position_parameter: owner ray distance times exp(log_delta); preserve owner ray
selection: minimum frozen-mask mean-over-cameras training Charbonnier at preregistered checkpoint steps; no GT
preflight: both arms pass FP64 finite differences, FP32 actual descent, 10-step loss decrease and support drop<=0.005 before formal training; reset to initial and fresh Adam for formal 200 steps
gt_scale: reuse existing E3b -002 initial E0b scale without refit; read only after training and selection
gt_mask: GT valid and raw E0 native depth valid; report coverage and common support across both arms initial/selected/last
